HeadlineCriteria.description:
Young's definition, as separately-evidenced criteria.

`result_class` is DERIVED from these in code (see derive_result_class), not
asserted by the model, so the label can never disagree with its own
criteria.

These are judged in a SEPARATE whole-paper pass (src/extract/headline.py),
not during table extraction. Two of the four criteria are comparative:
"preferred specification" is a claim relative to the paper's other columns,
and "not robustness or mechanism" is a claim about the paper's structure
(Table 5 is a robustness table *because* Table 2 is the main one). A call
scoped to one table can see neither, so judging there was unsound as well
as expensive.

critique_override_applied.description: True only when the paper critiques a standard specification and THIS is the stronger standard spec

mentioned_in_narrative.description: Referenced in the abstract, introduction, or conclusion

not_robustness_or_mechanism.description: True when this is NOT framed as a robustness check, sensitivity/placebo test, or mechanism exploration

preferred_specification.description: Authors treat this as a/the preferred specification

reasoning.description: One sentence on why the criteria fall as they do
reasoning.title: Reasoning

HeadlineCriteria.title: HeadlineCriteria

Regression.description: One regression = one table column (or one panel x column cell block).
Regression.title: Regression

RegressionSpec.description:
Everything someone with the DATA but not the CODE needs to re-run this.

Three rules the prompt enforces, because they separate a runnable spec from
a useless one: enumerate every control individually (never "demographic
controls"); dereference cross-references ("controls as in Table A3");
and state sample restrictions operationally, with the rule and the N.

cluster_level.description: Clustering dimension(s), e.g. 'state' or 'state x year'
cluster_level.title: Cluster Level

controls.description: EVERY control individually. Never an aggregate description.
controls.title: Controls

design.description: The identification design this column rests on, as the paper argues it (not the estimator): rct, did_event, iv, rdd, soo_matching, panel_fe, bunching, synthetic_control
design.title: Design

outcome_construction.description: How the dependent variable is built from raw data
outcome_construction.title: Outcome Construction

sample_restrictions.description: Operational restriction: the rule AND the resulting N where stated
sample_restrictions.title: Sample Restrictions

RegressionSpec.title: RegressionSpec

TargetRegressor.description:
The coefficient(s) the column is about.

Model-emitted with evidence, never inferred by substring matching. In the
old stack this flag came from `var_name.lower() in treatment_definition`
with "first row wins" as fallback — and it is the denominator of every
downstream match rate.

name.description: Row label of the regressor of interest, as printed
name.title: Name

why.description: Why this is the coefficient of interest
why.title: Why
